title: Relationships Are Simple. Simple Is Hard.
coreMove: Correction lands when it is personal enough to be heard and caring enough to keep the relationship intact.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Relationships run on a handful of simple ideas, but consistently practicing them under pressure is genuinely difficult, which is why so few people do it well.
